title: MathKX Skill
description: Exploratory 0.1 schema for a curriculum-independent mathematical skill, extended by specs/001 with the optional ladder and by specs/004 with the required name. A skill carries its stable identity, its learner-facing name per release language (kept apart from the identity, never used as one), its prerequisite edges, and optionally an ordered challenge ladder of its own exercise definitions with a learner-facing step description per release language. Descriptions and curriculum mappings for the skill itself still live elsewhere.

id.description: Stable, language-neutral skill ID such as numbers.square-roots. Must not encode a country, curriculum, grade, or display language.

name.description: The learner-facing name of the skill in each release language. Content, reviewed like lesson text; it may change without changing anything a record refers to.

prerequisites.description: IDs of skills this skill depends on. The graph across all skills must be acyclic.

ladder.description: Ordered from least to most demanding. Each entry names one of this skill's exercise definitions; 'Make it easier' and 'More challenge' move to the adjacent entry.
